aboutSnapshot.title: Since 2002, Kiarich Has Been Building Trust, One Family at a Time
aboutSnapshot.body: Agensi Pekerjaan Kiarich Sdn Bhd has spent more than 20 years bridging families and businesses with skilled domestic helpers. Our legacy is founded on professionalism and integrity — every helper undergoes rigorous training and selection to ensure they deliver service tailored to your household's needs.

servicesSection.title: Services Designed Around Your Family's Needs
servicesSection.subtitle: From elderly care to childcare and everyday household support, our carefully selected helpers are trained to bring expertise, efficiency and heart to every task.

elderly.title: Elderly Care
elderly.summary: We provide short-term and emergency assistance for elderly care.
elderly.body: Our core service is to offer caregivers and maids to assist elderly individuals or patients with their Activities of Daily Living (ADL). To ensure high-quality service, all assistants are carefully selected from our trusted nursing and elderly home partners. Every caregiver undergoes a thorough screening and selection process, ensuring we provide the best possible care for you and your loved ones.

children.title: Children Care
children.summary: Professional and reliable childcare services for your little ones.
children.body: We provide professional and reliable childcare services to ensure your little ones are well cared for in a safe and nurturing environment. Our trained caregivers offer personalised attention, assisting with daily activities, meals and learning — giving parents peace of mind while their children thrive.

specific.title: Household & Specific Services
specific.summary: Trusted maid services for the everyday needs of your household.
specific.body: Kiarich provides trusted and professional maid services to meet the diverse needs of households. Our experienced, well-trained maids assist with cleaning, household chores and other daily tasks, giving you more free time to enjoy with your family. We focus on reliable, efficient and affordable service, ensuring your home stays safe, clean and comfortable.

professional.title: Professional & Reliable Service
professional.body: Carefully selected and well-trained domestic helpers with excellent skills and attitudes.

trust.title: Trust & Safety
trust.body: Rigorous background checks and transparent communication ensure peace of mind.

ongoing.title: Ongoing Support
ongoing.body: Dedicated customer service and long-term partnerships for consistent quality.

process.eyebrow: A Step-by-Step Journey With Kiarich Agency
process.title: Simplified Maid Hiring
process.subtitle: From selection to handover — we make the process smooth and stress-free.

steps.title: Maid Selection
steps.body: We send maid profiles directly to you via WhatsApp. Interview videos are available, and personal online interviews can be arranged.

steps.title: Confirmation
steps.body: Secure your preferred maid with a deposit to kickstart the hiring process.

steps.title: Job Offer
steps.body: Finalise job details and have the candidate sign the Job Offer. A mandatory medical check-up will be conducted in the candidate's home country.

steps.title: Documentation
steps.body: Prepare the required documents using our checklist to ensure full compliance with government regulations.

steps.title: Processing
steps.body: We manage all submissions to the Labour Department (JTK), Immigration (IMM) and the Embassy to obtain approvals and visas. The entire process takes approximately 2–3 months, depending on government approval timelines.

steps.title: Maid Arrival
steps.body: Receive the maid's arrival schedule, final invoice and handover details.

steps.title: Handover
steps.body: After orientation and medical clearance, we officially hand over the maid to you.

about.heroSubtitle: Above 20 Years of Trust, Professionalism, and Excellence Maid Agency
about.storyBody1: With more than two decades of experience, Kiarich has become a trusted leader in bridging families and businesses with skilled domestic helpers. Since 2002, we have been committed to providing reliable solutions that transform lives and create lasting relationships built on trust and respect.
about.storyBody2: Our legacy is founded on professionalism and integrity. Every helper undergoes rigorous training and selection to ensure they deliver exceptional service tailored to meet diverse needs. From household management to caregiving, we empower helpers to bring expertise, efficiency, and heart to every task.
about.storyBody3: As a pioneer in the industry, Kiarich understands the importance of trust and security. We take pride in offering not just skilled helpers but peace of mind for families and businesses. Our mission is to ease the challenges of modern life by providing dependable support while fostering a positive impact on society.
